Open items stay open; UX and build are not authorised.

decisions.meaning: Use next-day plus 5/10/20-session formal forecast points; retain 3/6/12-month forecasts and separate 3–5-year scenarios. Quote/risk cadence stays 30 minutes where eligible. Exact monthly roll, targets, model catalogue and eligibility policies remain open.

decisions.answer: Calendar months; roll back to valid date
decisions.meaning: 3/6/12-month forecasts use calendar-month anniversaries, rolling back to the preceding valid session or valuation date when closed. Score only when canonical target-date value is available. This does not choose exact origin cutoffs, publication lag policy, thresholds or numerical model parameters.

later_owner_answers.note: Owner answers recorded after this pack was written, folded in by the MP-20 consolidation on 3 Nov 2026. The decision log is the authority; these entries point to it and add no FND-DEC ids. None approves the architecture baseline, UX or implementation.

answers.summary: ARC-01 confirmed: Yahoo Finance plus Twelve Data Grow 55 ($29 a month) for prod, Twelve Data Basic for dev; personal hobby use, not commercial; the published-terms risk accepted; no vendor contacted; Region Virginia (us-east-1). The Apple fee exception month was later refined (3 Nov, item 10).

ARC-06b option A: Haiku for triage, model inputs and extraction; Opus for event analysis, at most three a day, batched; Sonnet for chat, explanations, the briefing and evaluation judges. Every route passes its evaluation first.

Terraform only from the first resource; SSM Parameter Store SecureString; AWS Organizations with all features and the cost-guard SCP; the existing domain mypaisapp.com renewed outside MP; network N0; a read-only Cost Explorer role in the management account for the prod collector; global Claude inference at the standard price.

All seven event kinds in the first event wave (US, UK, India), each qualifying on its own evidence; similar days since 2015; bounded self-correction by code, never an agent; holdings plus the top 5 per segment.

Data: segments, additions from chat, the ~150-name universe, UK and Indian funds, Yahoo kept for India, the scan up to 5 GBP (items 1 to 3, 8, 9, 12, 19). Forecasting: bands, trial, revert, slipping, restart, unscored weeks, rules changes, probation, contribution split, F7 (items 4 to 6, 11, 13 to 18, 20). Release workflow only the owner can start (7). Apple not for now (10). One-pass consolidation with review round 1 before the owner signs (21).
